message: Module storage `S` cannot be lent to `viaAlias`, which lets its parameter `a` go further than indexing: storage keeps its length, so a callee it is lent to only indexes the parameter, reads its `length`, loops over it, calls a method that reads it, or lends it on the same way — never passes it elsewhere, binds, returns or stores it, where it could be spelled `T[]` and resized
